features.name: Identity
features.note: Get Package responds in both. WinUI renders full package identity (Name, Version, Architecture, ResourceId, Publisher, PublisherId, FullName, FamilyName, IsFramework) matching UWP, plus extra superset fields. Pass.

features.name: Installed Location
features.note: Get Installed Location responds in both, rendering 'Installed Location: <path>'. Path naturally points at the WinUI package's own AppX folder. Correct API behavior. Pass.

features.name: Dependencies
features.note: Get Dependencies responds in both, rendering 'Count: N' + list. UWP shows 3 .NET Native/VCLibs deps; WinUI shows 1 WindowsAppRuntime dep. Different framework deps are the correct, expected result for a WinUI 3 package; button is live and renders the real list. Pass.
